scope: Author-requested crew relief and correction of stationary port attackers; same pending PR/release
engine: GZDoom g4.14.2, Windows 11, Vulkan, Ryzen 9 5950X, RTX 3070 Ti, 1280x720, -noautoload -nosound

before_after.setup: Fresh full MAP06, invulnerable player at (0,6912,0), no reduced roster or waves. Positions compared every 175 native tics. Moved means more than 1 MU net displacement in that interval.
before_after.finding: Anima exhaustion blocked movement even with Air available. Port AI now suppresses unaffordable spells and resumes physical pursuit. No balance increase or diagnostic scheduler bypass was used.

relief.setup: One dead operator each on a small ram, hostile cannon and allied cannon. Living test combatants are invulnerable; guns are disarmed to isolate native recruitment/navigation from artillery displacement. Full roster is retained.
relief.results: Existing free combatants occupy the same slots; uniqueness, guard memory, no remote operation and repeat idempotence pass. Each recruit walks to its post; both guns have two present and the moving ram recovers its full crew.
relief.reload_scope: Saved identities/presence, temporary absence preserves living slot, large-ram replacement, neutralized machine cannot recruit/reactivate, no eligible reserve creates no extra unit.

saved_wait.result: PASS: original army survives loading with current code; 935 of 973 living attackers move over the next 175-tic sample, with three legitimate remaining resource waits. No army redeployment on load.

objectives.result: PASS: recruitment does not revive neutralized machines, invent kills, weaken the conjunction or duplicate victory; physical boss/survivor retreat and card availability remain.

mass_run.result: Completed without hang/crash. Real crowd contacts/obstruction remain; movement is not expected from actors attacking or holding assigned posts. Host log sampling is approximate, not rendering-FPS measurement.

investigation_limits: The first armed relief probe's new ram recruit reached its post, but a different living original crew member was displaced far away, so the full-crew assertion failed. Retained issue16_relief.log and issue16_relief_resume2.log document this; the isolated disarmed probe tests arrival separately from battle displacement.

Several diagnostic reload launches stopped producing frames after the map-load banner and reached the watchdog. No gameplay exception or root cause was established. The same saved relief state later passed under a debugger and in the normal isolated final run; the original PK3 save also passed normally. Earlier stalled logs are retained. These results do not establish a fix for intermittent engine/render startup or certify arbitrary saves; the author save test remains pending.
Test-only vector-array and conditional StateLabel compilation mistakes were corrected before successful runs; no saves were migrated or rewritten by those failed launches.
reproduction: Normal gameplay: lose one operator on a staffed machine with living free reserves; watch the nearest eligible same-side recruit walk to the slot. Repeat for small/large rams and both cannon sides, save/load en route. Kill all nearby guards to confirm permanent neutralization prevents recruitment.

Enter the fresh army and remain among it for at least 30 seconds. Low-Anima attackers must continue moving and melee when Air allows; spell use resumes only when affordable. Preserve the full force and resource values.
Static validation: python validate_project.py. Build: build_dev.ps1. Engine fixtures and saved games are local-only and not distributed. Archived logs trim trailing whitespace only.
author_acceptance: Pending CA-43627-PORT-01 and CA-43627-SAVE-01; reported failure is not acceptance
schema: No new serialized fields or state-label offsets; existing saved crew/operator arrays and entry references are reused
